The Workplace AI Product Owner is responsible for the end-to-end ownership of Anglicare's workplace AI product ecosystem. Operating within Digital and AI Enablement group of products, this role has organisation-wide reach and manages a growing portfolio of workplace AI capabilities, adoption pathways, enablement assets, governance processes, and approved automation scenarios that improve productivity, decision support, and staff effectiveness.

As part of a purpose-driven organisation, you will be working in a people-centred, collaborative, and values-led environment where your work directly contributes to enriching lives and strengthening communities.

Your opportunity

The Workplace AI Product Owner will maximise organisational value from workplace AI, by owning the systems, experiences, and enablement approaches that help staff adopt endorsed AI capabilities safely, practically, and at scale, continuously improving how workplace AI supports productivity, decision quality, and operational effectiveness through shared governance, insight, and product-led delivery.

With ownership, you will manage the following:

Product Ownership and Delivery

Translate the Workplace AI strategy and roadmap into prioritised initiatives, use cases, and delivery activities, ensuring the highest-value opportunities are progressed first.

Build strong relationships across leadership, business, and technology teams to align stakeholders around priorities, investment choices, and responsible adoption.

Define, measure, and report on Workplace AI product KPIs, adoption indicators, and benefit outcomes across personas and use cases.

Quantify how Workplace AI initiatives contribute to business outcomes such as time savings, improved quality, reduced cycle time, stronger decision support, and workforce effectiveness.
